comment: Where each package's source lives and where its "Report an issue" button goes. Read by scripts/fetch-downloads.py (release download counts), scripts/patch-depictions.py (the report button) and scripts/fetch-ratings.py. Every repo below was checked on 2026-11-21 against https://api.github.com/users/imod-commission/repos, and the .deb files attached to its releases are byte-identical to debs/. source: the open-source repository the "Source code" link on the package page points to (absent = no link: the source of HideLSClock is lost, Liquid Glass has no repository found and RounderLS is closed third-party; never guessed). repo: the GitHub repository (owner/name) whose releases carry the package's .deb files, or null when there is none. report: where the button leads. "repo" = https://github.com/<repo>/issues/new (the tweak's own issue tracker, needs Issues enabled there); "imod-repo" = the bug-report.yml form of this repository (for packages without a usable tracker of their own); "none" = no button. To move a package to its own tracker later, set report to "repo" (and repo, if it was null).

com.azzou.rounderls.reportNote: Third-party package by Azzou, included as it is: no report link.
